summary.headline: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 120.64% YoY to INR276.33 crores, but EBITDA margin compressed to 8.18% on raw-material and crude-linked cost pressure.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue from operations reached INR276.33 crores, up 120.64% YoY and 39.85% QoQ, with PAT of INR15.04 crores (up 130.67% YoY). EBITDA rose 94.41% YoY to INR22.59 crores, but consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 8.18% from 9.28% a year earlier and 10.19% in Q4 FY26. Management attributed the margin squeeze to dyes, chemicals, boiler fuel, LABSA and PP packaging costs linked to geopolitical crude volatility, which hit the textile business hardest. Installed FMCG and FMCG-intermediate capacity rose to 20,840 tons per month after a 1,700 MT soap line was commissioned at Roorkee. Management guides FY27 revenue of INR900-1,000 crores and a ~6% profitability level, with a further 0.75-1% improvement in FY28.

financial_highlights.change: +120.64% YoY vs INR125.24 crores; +39.85% QoQ vs INR197.59 crores

financial_highlights.metric: FMCG + FMCG intermediate share of consolidated revenue

segments.name: Roorkee facility
segments.commentary: Soap INR27.50 crores (vs INR17.63 crores in Q4 FY26) and noodles INR87.62 crores (vs INR44.47 crores in Q4 FY26).

segments.name: Bhilwara facility
segments.commentary: Home care and detergent INR40.98 crores (vs INR32.50 crores in Q4 FY26); edible INR30.34 crores (vs INR29.26 crores).

segments.name: Guwahati facility
segments.commentary: Cosmetics INR26.15 crores (vs INR20.91 crores in Q4 FY26); noodles INR37.75 crores (vs INR26.01 crores).

segments.name: Textile
segments.commentary: Management said textile revenue was roughly flat and margins were hit hardest by dye, chemical and fuel costs; no price increase could be passed through in the quarter. Long-run textile share guided at 8-10% of revenue.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue expected in INR900-1,000 crores; FY28 growth of 15-20% over FY27 cited, with the INR1,000 crores target for FY28 reiterated.
FY27 profitability expected around 6%, improving by 0.75-1% in FY28; a separate remark targets 7% by FY28 with EBITDA margin up another 2-2.5%.
Management expects raw-material cost pressure to normalise by Q3 or Q4 FY27; textile expected to turn good by Q3 FY27.
Near-term priority: neutralise the Q1 cost increase over the next two to three quarters and raise utilisation of recently added capacity over three to four quarters.
capex_capacity: Roorkee soap line commissioned in Q1 FY27 adds ~1,700 MT per month; aggregate FMCG and FMCG-intermediate capacity is 20,840 TPM (from 19,640 TPM at Q4 FY26).
Utilisation is currently ~50-55%; management expects another 25-30% utilisation gain by FY28.
Little further capacity addition expected over the next one to one-and-a-half years; only balancing capex is planned.
Bhilwara spices and savories plant runs one shift; second shift is free for expansion.
Management says existing capacity is enough to reach the INR1,000 crores FY28 revenue target without new capex.
demand_pricing: Revenue growth attributed to newly acquired units and new soap and FMCG capacity added in Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27, with customer base added during the quarter.
Business is B2B only; no B2C revenue. Over 200 customers, with quarterly planning forecasts and firm monthly orders.
Textile could not pass on dye, chemical and fuel cost increases in Q1; PP packaging prices spiked with geopolitical tension.
Spice margins described as lower and savory margins as higher.
Management expects revenue growth to come mainly from food and soap segments over the next two years.

qa_highlights.question: How did raw-material and crude-linked costs behave in the quarter and what is the outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Dyes, chemicals, consumables, boiler fuel and LABSA rose; PP packaging spiked. Textile prices could not be raised in Q1; management expects normalisation by Q3 or Q4.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 and FY28 revenue and profit outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: FY27 revenue INR900-1,000 crores, FY28 growth 15-20%; FY27 profitability about 6%, rising 0.75-1% in FY28.

qa_highlights.question: What is capacity utilisation and headroom?
qa_highlights.answer: Utilisation at 50-55%; another 25-30% expected by FY28; little new capex needed for one to one-and-a-half years.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the raised funds went to Roorkee, and is further fundraising planned?
qa_highlights.answer: Roorkee capacity was funded from the subsidiary's retained earnings. INR98.65 crores raised was used for Bhilwara food and Guwahati soap/noodle/cosmetics facilities, not for Sunrakshakk Agro acquisition, which predated the raise. No further fundraising is planned.

qa_highlights.question: Will textile continue or be demerged?
qa_highlights.answer: No demerger plans; textile is expected to improve by Q3 FY27 after a weak Q1.

qa_highlights.question: What are the next two to three quarter milestones?
qa_highlights.answer: Offset the Q1 cost increase and raise utilisation of recently added capacity over three to four quarters.

risks_watch: Consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 8.18% from 10.19% QoQ; recovery depends on input costs normalising by Q3 or Q4 FY27, which management itself flagged as uncertain given renewed pressure in Q2.
Utilisation of 50-55% versus the FY28 target rests on volume ramp; the INR1,000 crore target relies on existing capacity alone.
Textile profitability is weak; management expects a turnaround by Q3 FY27 but has not quantified it.
Working capital is described as balanced but management gave no specific target or days figure.
Some inconsistencies in the call: the FY28 margin guidance was given as +0.75-1% and, separately, as a 7% target with +2-2.5% EBITDA margin; the FMCG share was quoted as 90.60% and 90-91%.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth and capacity, with a clear focus on profitability recovery. Answers were often vague or repetitive on cost and margin specifics, and the management struggled with several individual investor questions on audibility and wording.
